nativeZh: n. 游戏, 游玩, 玩笑, 运动, 比赛, 赌博, 跳动, 表演, 剧本
v. 玩, 游戏, 假装, 开玩笑, 比赛, 扮演, 演奏, 演戏, 传摇曳, (使)跳动
[计] 播放

senses.en: a dramatic work intended for performance by actors on a stage
senses.zh: 供演员在舞台上表演的戏剧作品。

examples.en: he wrote several plays but only one was produced on Broadway
examples.zh: 他写了几部戏，但只有一部在百老汇上演。

senses.en: a theatrical performance of a drama
senses.zh: 戏剧表演

examples.en: the play lasted two hours
examples.zh: 这场戏演了两个小时。

senses.en: a preset plan of action in team sports
senses.zh: 团队体育中预先设定的行动计划

examples.en: the coach drew up the plays for her team
examples.zh: 教练为她的球队制定了战术配合。

senses.en: a deliberate coordinated movement requiring dexterity and skill
senses.zh: 有意作出的协调动作，需要灵巧和技巧。

examples.en: he made a great maneuver
examples.zh: 他完成了一次精彩的战术动作。

examples.en: the runner was out on a play by the shortstop
examples.zh: 游击手的一次防守使跑垒员出局。

senses.en: a state in which action is feasible
senses.zh: 可以采取行动的状态。

examples.en: the ball was still in play
examples.zh: 球仍处于比赛进行状态。

examples.en: insiders said the company's stock was in play
examples.zh: 知情人士称，该公司的股票正因潜在收购而受到争购。

senses.en: utilization or exercise
senses.zh: 运用；发挥。

examples.en: the play of the imagination
examples.zh: 想象力的发挥

senses.en: an attempt to get something
senses.zh: 试图得到的东西

examples.en: they made a futile play for power
examples.zh: 他们为争夺权力作了徒劳的努力。

examples.en: he made a bid to gain attention
examples.zh: 他试图引起注意

senses.en: activity by children that is guided more by imagination than by fixed rules
senses.zh: * 儿童的活动更多地以想象力而不是固定规则为指导

examples.en: Freud believed in the utility of play to a small child
examples.zh: 弗洛伊德相信玩耍对小孩有用

senses.en: (in games or plays or other performances) the time during which play proceeds
senses.zh: 比赛、戏剧或其他表演实际进行的时间。

examples.en: rain stopped play in the 4th inning
examples.zh: 比赛进行到第4局时因雨中断。

senses.en: the removal of constraints
senses.zh: 消除制约因素

examples.en: he gave free rein to his impulses
examples.zh: 他放任自己的冲动。

examples.en: they gave full play to the artist's talent
examples.zh: 他们使那位艺术家的才华得到了充分发挥。

senses.en: a weak and tremulous light
senses.zh: 一个弱而颤抖的光芒,

examples.en: the shimmer of colors on iridescent feathers
examples.zh: 虹彩羽毛上色彩流转的微光。

examples.en: the play of light on the water
examples.zh: 光线在水面上的闪动。

senses.en: verbal wit or mockery (often at another's expense but not to be taken seriously)
senses.zh: 机智的言语或打趣，常拿别人开玩笑，但并非当真。

examples.en: he became a figure of fun
examples.zh: 他成了人们取笑的对象。

examples.en: he said it in sport
examples.zh: 他说那话是开玩笑的。

senses.en: movement or space for movement
senses.zh: 移动或移动空间

examples.en: there was too much play in the steering wheel
examples.zh: 方向盘的自由间隙过大。

senses.en: gay or light-hearted recreational activity for diversion or amusement
senses.zh: 为消遣或娱乐而进行的愉快、轻松的活动。

examples.en: it was all done in play
examples.zh: 那一切都是闹着玩的。

examples.en: their frolic in the surf threatened to become ugly
examples.zh: 他们在海浪中的嬉闹眼看就要变成不愉快的冲突。

senses.en: (game) the activity of doing something in an agreed succession
senses.zh: （游戏）按约定顺序轮流行动。

examples.en: it is my turn
examples.zh: 轮到我

examples.en: it is still my play
examples.zh: 仍然轮到我出牌。

senses.en: the act of playing for stakes in the hope of winning (including the payment of a price for a chance to win a prize)
senses.zh: 以赢取赌注为目的的赌博行为，包括付费购买中奖机会。

examples.en: his gambling cost him a fortune
examples.zh: 他赌博花了他一大笔钱

examples.en: there was heavy play at the blackjack table
examples.zh: 二十一点牌桌上的赌注下得很大。

senses.en: the act using a sword (or other weapon) vigorously and skillfully
senses.zh: 有力而熟练地使用剑或其他武器的动作。

senses.en: participate in games or sport
senses.zh: 参加游戏或运动

examples.en: We played hockey all afternoon
examples.zh: 我们整个下午都玩曲棍球

examples.en: play cards
examples.zh: 玩牌

examples.en: Pele played for the Brazilian teams in many important matches
examples.zh: 贝利曾在许多重要比赛中代表巴西队出场。

senses.en: act or have an effect in a specified way or with a specific effect or outcome
senses.zh: 以特定方式发挥作用，或产生特定影响、结果。

examples.en: This factor played only a minor part in his decision
examples.zh: 这个因素在决定中只起了很小的作用

examples.en: This development played into her hands
examples.zh: 事情的发展恰好对她有利。

examples.en: I played no role in your dismissal
examples.zh: 你被解雇这件事与我无关。

senses.en: play on an instrument
senses.zh: 在乐器上演奏

examples.en: The band played all night long
examples.zh: 乐队整晚都在演奏

senses.en: play a role or part
senses.zh: 扮演某个角色。

examples.en: Gielgud played Hamlet
examples.zh: 吉尔古德扮演哈姆雷特

examples.en: She wants to act Lady Macbeth, but she is too young for the role
examples.zh: 她想演麦克白夫人但她太年轻了 不适合演这个角色

examples.en: She played the servant to her husband's master
examples.zh: 丈夫摆出主人的架势，她则充当顺从的仆人。

senses.en: be at play; be engaged in playful activity; amuse oneself in a way characteristic of children
senses.zh: 玩耍；从事游戏活动；像孩子一样自娱自乐。

examples.en: The kids were playing outside all day
examples.zh: 孩子们整天在外面玩

examples.en: I used to play with trucks as a little girl
examples.zh: 我小时候常玩玩具卡车。

senses.en: replay (as a melody)
senses.zh: 再次奏出或播放，例如一段旋律。

examples.en: Play it again, Sam
examples.zh: 再演奏一遍，山姆。

examples.en: She played the third movement very beautifully
examples.zh: 她把第三乐章演奏得非常优美。

senses.en: perform music on (a musical instrument)
senses.zh: 用某种乐器演奏音乐。

examples.en: He plays the flute
examples.zh: 他吹长笛。

examples.en: Can you play on this old recorder?
examples.zh: 你会吹这支旧竖笛吗？

senses.en: pretend to have certain qualities or state of mind
senses.zh: 假装有 某些品质或精神状态

examples.en: He acted the idiot
examples.zh: 他装傻了

examples.en: She plays deaf when the news are bad
examples.zh: 消息不好的时候她会装聋作哑

senses.en: move or seem to move quickly, lightly, or irregularly
senses.zh: 移动或似乎移动迅速,轻或不规则

examples.en: The spotlights played on the politicians
examples.zh: 聚光灯的光扫过那些政界人士。

senses.en: bet or wager (money)
senses.zh: 赌注或赌注(金钱)

examples.en: He played $20 on the new horse
examples.zh: 他在那匹新马上下注20美元。

examples.en: She plays the races
examples.zh: 她赌赛马。

senses.en: engage in recreational activities rather than work; occupy oneself in a diversion
senses.zh: 从事娱乐而非工作；进行消遣活动。

examples.en: On weekends I play
examples.zh: 周末我玩游戏

examples.en: The students all recreate alike
examples.zh: 学生们都采用相同的方式消遣。

senses.en: pretend to be somebody in the framework of a game or playful activity
senses.zh: 在游戏或玩耍中假扮某人。

examples.en: Let's play like I am mommy
examples.zh: 我们来玩假装我是妈妈的游戏吧。

examples.en: Play cowboy and Indians
examples.zh: 玩牛仔和印第安人游戏

senses.en: emit recorded sound
senses.zh: 播放录制好的声音。

examples.en: The tape was playing for hours
examples.zh: 录音带播放了好几个小时

examples.en: the stereo was playing Beethoven when I entered
examples.zh: 我进来时，音响正在播放贝多芬的作品。

senses.en: perform on a certain location
senses.zh: 在某个场所演出。

examples.en: The prodigy played Carnegie Hall at the age of 16
examples.zh: 天才16岁时在卡内基音乐厅演出

examples.en: She has been playing on Broadway for years
examples.zh: 她已经在百老汇演出多年了。

senses.en: put (a card or piece) into play during a game, or act strategically as if in a card game
senses.zh: 在游戏中出牌或走棋，也比喻像打牌一样运用策略。

examples.en: He is playing his cards close to his chest
examples.zh: 他对自己的计划守口如瓶。

examples.en: The Democrats still have some cards to play before they will concede the electoral victory
examples.zh: 民主党人在承认对方赢得选举之前，还有一些策略可用。

senses.en: engage in an activity as if it were a game rather than take it seriously
senses.zh: 参与一个活动,就像它是一个游戏,而不是把它当回事

examples.en: They played games on their opponents
examples.zh: 他们对对手耍了手段。

examples.en: play the stock market
examples.zh: 投机买卖股票。

examples.en: play with her feelings
examples.zh: 玩弄她的感情。

examples.en: toy with an idea
examples.zh: 漫不经心地考虑一个想法。

senses.en: behave in a certain way
senses.zh: 以某种方式行事

examples.en: play safe
examples.zh: 谨慎行事。

examples.en: play it safe
examples.zh: 采取稳妥的做法。

examples.en: play fair
examples.zh: 公平游戏

senses.en: cause to emit recorded audio or video
senses.zh: 使设备播放录制好的音频或视频。

examples.en: They ran the tapes over and over again
examples.zh: 他们一遍又一遍地播放那些磁带。

examples.en: I'll play you my favorite record
examples.zh: 我放一张我最喜欢的唱片给你听。

examples.en: He never tires of playing that video
examples.zh: 他从不厌倦播放那段视频

senses.en: manipulate manually or in one's mind or imagination
senses.zh: 手动操作,或者在一个人的思想或想象中操作

examples.en: She played nervously with her wedding ring
examples.zh: 她紧张地摆弄着自己的婚戒。

examples.en: Don't fiddle with the screws
examples.zh: 别乱动那些螺丝。

examples.en: He played with the idea of running for the Senate
examples.zh: 他曾随意考虑过竞选参议员的想法。

senses.en: use to one's advantage
senses.zh: 利用……为自己谋利。

examples.en: She plays on her clients' emotions
examples.zh: 她利用客户的情绪。

senses.en: consider not very seriously
senses.zh: 考虑得不太认真

examples.en: He is trifling with her
examples.zh: 他在玩弄她的感情。

examples.en: She plays with the thought of moving to Tasmania
examples.zh: 她有时会想想搬去塔斯马尼亚的可能性。

senses.en: be received or accepted or interpreted in a specific way
senses.zh: 以特定方式收到或接受或解释

examples.en: This speech didn't play well with the American public
examples.zh: 这篇演说没有得到美国公众的良好反响。

examples.en: His remarks played to the suspicions of the committee
examples.zh: 他的言论迎合了委员会的疑虑。

senses.en: behave carelessly or indifferently
senses.zh: 轻举妄动或无动于衷

examples.en: Play about with a young girl's affection
examples.zh: 玩弄一个年轻姑娘的感情。

senses.en: cause to move or operate freely within a bounded space
senses.zh: 使之在限定空间内自由移动或运作。

examples.en: The engine has a wheel that is playing in a rack
examples.zh: 这台发动机有一个能在齿条中来回运动的轮子。

senses.en: perform on a stage or theater
senses.zh: 在舞台或剧院表演

examples.en: She acts in this play
examples.zh: 她演这部戏

examples.en: He acted in `Julius Caesar'
examples.zh: 他参演了《尤利乌斯·凯撒》。

examples.en: I played in `A Christmas Carol'
examples.zh: 我参演过《圣诞颂歌》。

senses.en: be performed or presented for public viewing
senses.zh: 被演出或展示给公众观看。

examples.en: What's playing in the local movie theater?
examples.zh: 当地电影院播放什么?.

examples.en: `Cats' has been playing on Broadway for many years
examples.zh: 《猫》已在百老汇上演多年。

senses.en: cause to happen or to occur as a consequence
senses.zh: 使某事发生或产生某种结果。

examples.en: I cannot work a miracle
examples.zh: 我无法创造奇迹

examples.en: wreak havoc
examples.zh: 造成严重破坏。

examples.en: bring comments
examples.zh: 引来评论。

examples.en: play a joke
examples.zh: 开玩笑

examples.en: The rain brought relief to the drought-stricken area
examples.zh: 这场雨缓解了受旱地区的困境。

senses.en: discharge or direct or be discharged or directed as if in a continuous stream
senses.zh: 像连续水流那样喷出、喷射或引导流向。

examples.en: play water from a hose
examples.zh: 用软管喷水。

examples.en: The fountains played all day
examples.zh: 喷泉一整天都在喷水。

senses.en: make bets
senses.zh: 下注。

examples.en: Play the races
examples.zh: 赌赛马。

examples.en: play the casinos in Trouville
examples.zh: 在特鲁维尔的赌场玩

senses.en: stake on the outcome of an issue
senses.zh: 把赌注押在某件事的结果上。

examples.en: I bet $100 on that new horse
examples.zh: 我在那匹新马上赌了100美元。

examples.en: She played all her money on the dark horse
examples.zh: 她把所有的钱都押在了那匹不被看好的马上。

senses.en: shoot or hit in a particular manner
senses.zh: 以特定方式射击或击打

examples.en: She played a good backhand last night
examples.zh: 她昨晚打出了漂亮的反手球。

senses.en: use or move
senses.zh: 使用或移动

examples.en: I had to play my queen
examples.zh: 我不得不走皇后这枚棋子。

senses.en: employ in a game or in a specific position
senses.zh: 在比赛中使用某名选手，或安排其担任特定位置。

examples.en: They played him on first base
examples.zh: 他们安排他担任一垒手。

senses.en: contend against an opponent in a sport, game, or battle
senses.zh: 在运动、比赛或战斗中与对手对战

examples.en: Princeton plays Yale this weekend
examples.zh: 普林斯顿队这个周末将对阵耶鲁队。

examples.en: Charlie likes to play Mary
examples.zh: 查理喜欢与玛丽对阵。

senses.en: exhaust by allowing to pull on the line
senses.zh: 让上钩的鱼拉扯鱼线，直到它精疲力尽。

examples.en: play a hooked fish
examples.zh: 遛一条已上钩的鱼，使它疲乏。
